author: KitchenAid
title: Kale Chia Smoothie
ingredients: 1 ripe avocado, halved, stone and skin discarded
several small ice cubes (about ¼ cup)
instructions_list: For best results use a KitchenAid® Diamond Blender.
Add the pineapple, kale, kiwi, avocado, yoghurt, orange juice, ice and mint to the blender.
Select Liquify and blend for 30 seconds or until smooth. Add the chia seeds pulse 2-3 times.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
description: Healthy, creamy and delicious! Add the chia seeds at the end to keep a little of the texture from the seeds. Makes 750ml
